subject.title: fix(plugins): preserve settings for compatibility IDs

question: Should this PR’s intentional consolidation of compatibility-ID settings into one canonical persisted plugin entry be accepted as the supported upgrade behavior?
rationale: The change affects persisted user configuration and source/runtime write projection; tests describe the intended behavior, but accepting the data-normalization policy is an owner decision.

options.title: Accept canonical consolidation
options.body: Confirm that aliases and mixed-case compatibility IDs should be folded into one canonical entry while canonical values win conflicts.

options.title: Require a narrower compatibility policy
options.body: Keep an alternative migration or preservation rule if existing compatibility-key spelling must remain visible after CLI mutations.

recommendation.title: Accept canonical consolidation
recommendation.body: Confirm that aliases and mixed-case compatibility IDs should be folded into one canonical entry while canonical values win conflicts.

likelyOwner.reason: This PR implements the proposed persisted-config compatibility behavior and is the closest available routing candidate.
